rafa: Heads-up I'm assembling a small PR to update the Optimize migration guide for enterprise customers. Items: 1) add a Rust SDK snippet showing batching + prefix cache + a quant profile example, 2) include a short CLI cache-warm example for Dedicated/Private, 3) fix a broken anchor under /optimize/enterprise/migrate. tagging @mei @owen for snippet and test help
mei: Nice. Rust snippet would be greatwe don't have Rust examples in Optimize yet. Can you paste a draft so I can sanity-check types and imports?
rafa: Draft Rust snippet (to go under docs/examples/sdk/rust):
```rust
use redwood::Client;
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
  let client = Client::from_env();
  let req = redwood::GenerateRequest {
    model: "redwood/enterprise-compact-v1".into(),
    input: "Summarize this policy paragraph in one sentence.".into(),
    batching: Some(redwood::Batching { max_batch_tokens: 1500 }),
    cache: Some(redwood::CacheConfig { mode: "prefix".into(), max_prefix_kv: 4096 }),
    quant_profile: Some("q5_0_moderate".into()),
    ..Default::default()
  };
  let resp = client.generate(req).await?;
  println!("{}", resp.text);
  Ok(())
}
```
ome: Looks good. Two suggestions: add a brief comment about `max_batch_tokens` tradeoff and add a one-liner on `q5_0_moderate` (balanced memory/quality). Also add a tiny test that verifies the response contains a short expected phrase to keep CI cheap.
owen: I'll add a small CLI example for ops teams to warm prefix caches before rolling traffic:
```bash
# prewarm cache for model on Dedicated pool
redwoodctl cache prewarm --model redwood/enterprise-compact-v1 --prefix "policy:" --concurrency 4 --batch-tokens 1500
```
This helps steady latency on first requests for heavy KV workloads.
samira: For the migration checklist, please include this bullet: "Enterprise: when migrating to quant profiles, validate on a private staging dataset and run smoke eval (threshold >= 0.95) before enabling on production Dedicated pools." Also add links to the Dedicated config page and the new Rust snippet.
eng-infra: CI linkcheck reported an old anchor at `/optimize/enterprise/quant` in main. I'll add a redirect to `/optimize/quantization/profiles` in the PR and grep for other hits. I can push the redirect patch to your branch if you want.
rafa: Please push it, that saves time. Plan: I'll open PR after adding the Rust snippet, CLI example, migration checklist, and a 3-prompt smoke test. @mei can you review formatting? @owen can you add the smoke-test harness?
